original_target.title: Unbounded chromatic number of associahedron graphs

scope_comparison: The new double-logarithmic upper bound is substantial partial progress but does not determine whether the chromatic number is unbounded. Its section5 explicitly asks whether an absolute constant suffices. The October simpler logarithmic theorem is also only an upper bound.
